result.brief: 以元胞自动机为测试床，揭示常规世界模型在空间/时间局部性与时间稳定性上的三类失败模式，并给出仅改信息流、不动骨干的修复方案。
result.reason: Analyzes why world models (autoregressive/diffusion) fail to learn exact cellular automata dynamics, with fixes for spatial/temporal locality and stability; directly about world modeling and rollout prediction.
